text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOOOH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(So this is a Senior Class race...!
Differences in skill and experience show through more than ever before—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: However... I felt it... that spark...!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Because differences in technique and experience show, there's so much to learn from a single race...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(I'll build upon this experience and
aim for even greater heights—)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (...I can fight just fine. In middle-distance races in the Senior Class...!)

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: (Keeping up this momentum, next is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: —Splendid, as always.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Drawing strength from today's result,
she is already looking ahead to what's next.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "...I believe that applies more to McQueen-san instead."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"For you, and for the Mejiro family,
the upcoming Tenno Sho (Spring) is—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Yes.
...It is a stage where our long-cherished wish is on the line. Therefore—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: "I fully intend to bring a version of myself that surpasses today's and claim victory in that race."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
(A resolve honed to an even sharper edge—
She truly is terrifying...!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Let us strive once more. Toward the next stage.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next time, once more—
—A few days later.

text_block_list.name: Race Fan A
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, whoa, whoa, are you serious?
Word is Ikuno Dictus is planning to run in the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Race Fan B
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, she can run long distance...!?
If that's true, that's incredible...!"

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
"I know Mejiro McQueen still has the upper hand, naturally,
but aside from that, I can't help feeling worried."

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
Well, 3,200m is... pretty long after all.
Miles and middle distances are my main battlegrounds anyway.
Among the public, news of Ikuno Dictus entering the Tenno Sho (Spring) had become quite a hot topic in certain circles...
Most were concerned about whether she could handle 3,200 meters, but—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
—Drawing more attention is a good thing.
Having it deemed 'difficult' also presents
a great opportunity.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"That's why when I do get results,
it resonates all the more deeply."

In terms of distance aptitude, this will without a doubt
be her toughest race yet. But—

If it's Ikuno Dictus, she can definitely make it through the Tenno Sho (Spring).
Deep down, I felt something close to certainty.
choice_data_list: —How's the fatigue from the Osaka Hai?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: By my own assessment... I'd say my recovery is at about 70%.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Affirming that analysis.
Recommending increasing cross-training intensity by 1 level and proceeding with recovery."
choice_data_list: OK, let's start with the stationary bike today.

text_block_list.text:
—Until the fatigue is completely gone,
I want to carefully continue cross-training with light exercises other than running.

At this rate, you should be able to do some slow-paced
jogging by tomorrow.
I'd say your recovery is progressing quite smoothly.

text_block_list.name: IRON WILL
text_block_list.text:
"Feedback received.
Reconstructing today's nutritional and training regimens.
Please confirm them later."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
There are many challenges ahead of the 3,200m race...
We'll just have to tackle them one by one.
choice_data_list: Yeah. There's no need to rush.

text_block_list.text:
“—As the days continue to build, both I,
Ikuno Dictus, and 'IRON WILL'
are growing together.”
Keeping that realization firmly in mind, let's steadily do everything we can with the time we have left.

The battle leading up to the Tenno Sho (Spring)
has already begun, after all—
